## How did you test it?

- [ ] Tried it in a browser with `web/index.html`
- [ ] Built the Mac app with `./build.sh` and played it from the menu bar
- [ ] Built the Windows app (only needed if you changed `windows/`)
- [ ] Checked light and dark, Compact and Large

## Checklist

- [ ] Works offline and makes no network requests
- [ ] Keyboard friendly, and the controls hint under the game is up to date
- [ ] Pauses cleanly when the panel closes, and resumes where it left off
- [ ] No third-party code or assets unless the licence allows it and it is listed in `NOTICE`
- [ ] No personal paths, emails or signing details added
- [ ] I agree my contribution is released under the MIT licence
